EMPOWERING MSMES TO GROW THEIR BUSINESSES
Diamond Trust Bank (DTB), in partnership with the Kenya Bankers Association (KBA), has been hosting an online series of financial literacy training
sessions aimed at empowering micro and small-business owners to grow their businesses.
The 8-module programme is an accredited programme which is being delivered by certified trainers. Upon completion of all the modules,
participants are awarded a certificate accredited by KBA and DTB. The sessions are held online via Microsoft Teams, and are availed at no cost to
the participants.
Over 500
MSME operators across Kenya have
been trainedsince 2019 with
an additional 400
MSME operators
across Kenya targeted to be trained in
2021.
